comment: The standards the exports are checked against (check_standard.py). folder may use environment variables (%OneDriveCommercial%). ids is a file pattern in the folder; each export is checked with every matching IDS. workbook is a data dictionary workbook in the usBridge layout (one sheet per IFC class: Entity, IFC Attributes, and property set sections); the standard mapping table is compared with it. classification_system is the table's classification system whose identifications name the workbook classes (prefix is removed).
